note: Played once at game launch. Cannot be skipped. Movement unlocks when finished. `lines` play in order; each optional `cue` fires a shell animation (reveal_rails brightens the star shelves). gen_vo.py bakes one WAV per line into assets/audio/vo/intro/<key>.wav.

lines.text: When I stop talking, tap the ground to walk through your nest.
Follow the glowing trails to try different ant jobs.
Now look at the sides. Your star shelves are hiding under the soil. Here they come!
All twelve stars start dim, because they are still locked.
Walk up to a shiny golden star in the nest to light one up here. Can you find all twelve?
The shelves rest under the soil. Touch a side any time to peek at your stars!
